faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the District Court Sarguja Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the District Court Sarguja Recruitment 2026 is 13th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Grade-3 and Bhritiya posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the District Court Sarguja Recruitment 2026. This includes vacancies for both Assistant Grade-3 and Bhritiya (Peon) positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 30 years for all the posts announced in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant Grade-3?
faq.answer: For the Assistant Grade-3 post, candidates must be graduates from a recognized university and possess a one-year computer diploma. Knowledge of Hindi and English typing on a computer is also essential.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for the Bhritiya (Peon) post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Bhritiya (Peon) post must have passed the 8th class from a recognized board. Knowledge of the local Chhattisgarhi language is also required.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the District Court Sarguja Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive salaries as per Pay Matrix Level-04 (Rs. 19500-62000) for Assistant Grade-3 and Level-01 (Rs. 15600-49400) for Bhritiya (Peon).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these government jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a Written Test, followed by a Skill Test/Aptitude Test, and finally Document Verification for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the District Court Sarguja Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Court Sarguja, which is https://surguja.dcourts.gov.in.
